Petitioner Vs. 1.The State of Tamil Nadu Rep. by its Principal Secretary to Government, Municipal Administration, St. George Fort, Chennai - 600 009. 2.The Commissioner for Municipal Administration, Department of Municipal Administration, Government of Tamil Nadu, Chepauk, Chennai - 600 005. 3.The Commissioner, Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration, No.33, West Jones Road, Saidapet, Chennai - 600 015. 4.The District Collector, Villupuram District, Villupuram. http://www.judis.nic.in 2 5.The Revenue Divisional Officer, Kallakurichi Revenue Division, Kallakurichi, A.Kasivel vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 19 June, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84087904/ 1 Villupuram District. 6.The Joint Director, Municipal Administration, Vellore Region, Vellore. 7.The Commissioner, Kallakurichi Municipality, Kallakurichi, Villupuram District. 8.The Designated Officer/Food Safety Officer, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Food Safety Wing, Collectorate, Villupuram, Villupuram District . 9.Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (Fssai), Fda Bhavan, Kotla Road, New Delhi - 110 002. 10.Sri Vasavi Sweets and Backery, Rep. by its Sole Proprietor, P. Yuvaraji Krishnan, No.78, Thirumalai Thirupathi Nagar, Katchirayapalayam Road, Kallakurichi - 606 202, Villupuram District. ... Responden Prayer:
texts.facts: 4. A perusal of paragraph No.8 of the report filed by the Commissioner, Kallakurichi Municipality, would show that, no manufacturing activity is done, in the abovesaid primeses, the said shop has been closed and the licence cancelled. For brevity, paragraph No.8 of the report dated 17.06.2019, filed by the Commissioner, Kallakurichi Municipality, is extracted hereunder:- "8. I submit that the 10th respondent made an application dated 23.04.2019 praying to remove the seal without making any application as ordered by the Hon'ble Division Bench to seek license. The 10th respondent requested to clean the premises and for which he sought 1 month time which was refused and granted only two weeks time for cleaning purpose and also for the purpose of plastering the damaged floor and to white wash the premises for making application for license within the period as directed by this Hon'ble Court. It is to be noted that no business activity of manufacturing of sweets and karam was carried out by the 10th respondent during the aforesaid period. On completion of the cleaning work, removal of hazardous waste like oil tins, waste oils from which bad odour was emanating, card board boxes, damaged vessels etc., other personnel items, also the painting and plastering works were carried and thus the shop was locked. I bet to submit that I reiterate no manufacturing activity is being conduced in the said premises."
